scope: Preview-only publish harmless verification nonce before awaiting controller, enabling the real separately restricted worker to join the exact isolated task.
riskAnalysis: The external restricted verification driver must receive the nonce while owner supervision is active. Publishing only after response would prevent actual hosted participation; nonce is not a capability or paid authority.

threatModel.assets: Owner session, exact approved task, immutable evidence, central Redis authority, spending reservations and Production isolation.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Authenticated dashboard to same-origin guarded owner API; supervisor to restricted worker; central CAS across deployments; untrusted receipts to text-only display.
threatModel.abuseCases: Nonowner/worker impersonation; stale or changed expiration approval; duplicate Start; disconnected owner; partial activation; revoked old deployment; Redis outage; leaking task capabilities.
threatModel.mitigations: Current server owner/session/origin/Preview checks; full approval digest and exact deployment selection; existing one-use CAS/leases; independent central owner revoke and readback; no minting/limits inputs; provider-inaccessible inert verification.

rollback: Keep paid false; remove temporary inert window, revoke all test records and verify old/current/replacement brokers. Restore reviewed feature source only if needed; preserve historical ledger/evidence and Production.

defects.rootCause: Verification task reference was only recorded after awaiting the owner controller result.
defects.detectionGap: Local integration had direct access to request DTO; a real hosted worker requires a visible reference before controller completion.
defects.regression: Executed UI test asserts visible nonce before the real supervisor request waits, while fixed zero-call worker authorization remains enforced.
defects.historicalPrevention: Hosted readiness cannot be inferred from a fixture-only out-of-band nonce; visible record linkage now exists before worker bootstrap.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing authoritative controller/worker/Redis/provider path reused; no duplicate execution system.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Owner browser session and same-origin fetch are explicit dependencies; platform protection and Redis remain unchanged.
proactiveReview.threats: Exact approval mutation, stale deployment, disconnected owner and orphan authority reviewed independently.
proactiveReview.failureModes: AO-04 now includes supported owner entrypoint and cross-deployment cleanup; sixteen-item register preserved.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Actual handler/CAS expiry/replay/revoke races, session loss, Redis outage and restricted transport tests; hosted infrastructure fault gaps remain explicit.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Engineering Auditor and QA inspect actual implementation and negative tests; no implementing-agent-only readiness.
proactiveReview.recovery: Owner central revocation independent of stream; pre-task tombstone and expired disabled replacement cleanup; no paid retries.
